headline: Pajson Agro India approves an acquisition valued at Rs 354.52 crore
hook: Expansion deal worth hundreds of crores
summary: Pajson Agro India Limited has formally approved a corporate acquisition worth Rs 354.52 crore. The transaction marks a notable expansion move by the company through inorganic growth. Specific details regarding the target entity and funding structure were not immediately disclosed in the notice. Retail investors should monitor future regulatory filings for potential equity dilution or debt implications arising from this deal.
why_it_matters: Large acquisitions can alter capital structure and earnings trajectory.
